title: Determination of gold content in rock gold ore samples based on closed water bath aqua regia digestion-polyurethane foam enrichment and using flame atomic absorption spectrometry
content:

At present, due to the uneven distribution and low content of gold (Au) in rock gold ore samples, the separation, enrichment and accurate determination of Au have become daunting tasks in the analysis of rock gold samples.
